### Rich Oppressors
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/rich-oppressors
Passage: James 5:1-6
Points:
- James strongly rebukes those who seek ultimate security in perishable worldly wealth.
- Hoarding riches through dishonesty and defrauding laborers invites divine judgment.
- Knowing God will avenge the oppressed helps mistreated believers endure hardships with patience.
- Material abundance provides no protection when Christ returns to judge all that lacks eternal value.
- Believers are challenged to examine their spending and faithfully use their resources for God's kingdom.
